description: This file defines a set of functions and data structures for parsing, validating, and encoding JSON Lines specific to the A2UI protocol version 0.8. It includes the ParsedItem struct, which holds line number and message, and functions for parsing JSONL text, validating messages against expected allowed keys, decoding messages, and encoding messages as JSON arrays.

classes.name: ParsedItem
classes.description: A simple data structure representing a parsed line from JSONL with its line number and message message as AnyCodable.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string containing JSON Lines, decodes each line into AnyCodable, and returns an array of ParsedItem.

methods.name: validateV0_8
methods.description: Validates parsed items to ensure they conform to the expected message structure for A2UI v0.8, checking for expected keys and correct message format.

methods.name: decodeMessagesFromJSONL
methods.description: Decode JSONL text into a list of message objects after parsing and validation.

methods.name: encodeMessagesJSONArray
methods.description: Encodes a list of messages into a JSON array string.
